name: youtube-metadata-flashdata
description: Read YouTube video details, descriptions, statistics and available chapters. Inspect formats or prepare timestamped chapter navigation. Uses the paid FlashData API.

FLASHDATA_API_KEY.title: FlashData API key
FLASHDATA_API_KEY.description: FlashData API key from https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys with youtube_metadata enabled. Data calls use paid Credits; pricing and job reads are free.
